info.name: MLHeroes API
info.description:
Mobile Legends hero API (plain PHP + MySQL on Freehostia).

Every response uses the envelope { success, message, data, meta? }.

**Before running:** select the 'MLHeroes - live' environment and set `adminKey` to the ADMIN_KEY value from backend/config/database.php. Never commit the real key.

**Safe to run end to end.** The write folder creates one throwaway hero, exercises it, and deletes it again, so the 133-hero roster is left exactly as it was found. Requests marked REGRESSION TEST cover bugs found in QA - they must stay green.
